title: Wiemer dot field
description: A perforated-plate backdrop: a 12×9 grid of pale round dots behind centred content (a form card). Each dot turns dark grey the moment the pointer touches it and fades back over 0.8s, so the pointer leaves a short trail. Dots show from large screens up.
notes: CSS only; the trail is a plain transition with no delay on and a slow fade off
below lg the content sits in normal flow without dots
